environment.environment_policy: allowlist; temporary HOME/PWD/SHELL/XDG/TMPDIR; no user configs

method.latency: write start to ASCII ACK plus following ESC[?2026l received on outer PTY
method.cpu: PROC_PIDTASKINFO=4, 96-byte Darwin proc_taskinfo; pti_total_user/system Mach ticks converted to ns with mach_timebase_info
method.cpu_scope: tpane PID, all threads; excludes Python children and benchmark driver
method.memory: tpane PID resident and virtual bytes at phase boundaries, not peak or system-wide memory
method.cpu_percent: 100% = one fully occupied core; may exceed 100%
method.ps: before/after PID, PPID, aggregate CPU time, command; coarse corroboration only
method.order: trial-major, pane counts in CLI order; fresh process per case
limitations: not physical display or Ghostty GUI latency
driver scheduling, PTY transport and Python backend affect wall time
finite-output throughput includes backend production and final render; frames may coalesce
latency CPU includes 0-20ms seeded think times
1 pane has 29 terminal rows; multiple panes have 28 (two bars)
CPU sample boundaries include small libproc-call overhead
no control over unrelated load, thermals, power state or binary build flags
ps CPU time is coarse; ABI/thread count/monotonicity checked; timebase conversion checked against driver process_time_ns
